repository.executionRule: Run one staged meal-grid pilot only from a clean descendant containing the category-aware Planner contract. A892 completed all twenty-four provider calls but retrieved only nine assignable recipe bodies after its unscoped initial queries mixed cuisine with irrelevant PostgreSQL and manual content. For structured named-item collections, allow an exact listed category only when its label clearly and unambiguously matches the requested information domain, and retain at least one complementary unscoped query. Keep Terra, 24 provider calls, 48 documentary calls, 512 evidence items, 300000 ms tool time, 1.10 USD per-job cap, 50 USD lifetime stop, corpus, all other prompts and acceptance rules frozen.

execution.artifactDirectoryRule: Create a fresh directory containing the exact execution commit and UTC timestamp; never overwrite an earlier pilot.

budget.authorizationBasis: On 2026-09-29 the user explicitly authorized use of all purchased OpenAI credits and added the current 5 USD extension. The local lifetime hard stop remains 50 USD, with no automatic purchase. A892 consumed 0.75561500 USD in twenty-four calls and exposed unscoped initial retrieval as the dominant variance source. The persistent ledger now records 47.96152810 USD, leaving 2.03847190 USD and satisfying the complete 1.10 USD A893 staged-job reservation.

pilot: The one registered meal-grid case completes on the exact clean execution state with the sealed reference corpus unchanged.

The preflight seal proves Responses transport, agent topology, workspace, 32768 history characters, staged Candidate Explorer enabled, 4096-token Judge/Navigator output budget, twenty-four total provider calls and forty-eight documentary tool calls under the unchanged 1.10 USD job cap.
The Planner uses the exact listed cuisine category for at least one structured candidate query when it is present in availableCategories, while keeping at least one complementary unscoped query.

Private provider traces contain planner, at least one candidate-navigator-N role, at least one candidate-judge-N role, writer and critic; the staged evidence verifier rejects the run if one stage is absent.
The deterministic solver reports maximumAssignableCount 20 and proposedAssignments 20 before the final answer; per-role counts alone are insufficient.

The final result is answered with twenty concrete, distinct and semantically suitable selections, one for every weekday and meal moment, each tied to its assigned canonical body EvidenceId and exact source reference.
The durable job, tool events, research checkpoint, provider telemetry, final claims and source payload are preserved for mechanical and human semantic review.
A precise bounded gap is safe behavior but fails this functional pilot when the historical corpus contains the missing bodies.
acceptance.progressionRule: A semantically reviewed A893 success freezes this configuration and permits one exact repetition only while a complete 1.10 USD reservation remains under the 50 USD lifetime stop. Any failure returns to causal trace review and ends the OpenAI campaign if a full reservation is unavailable.
acceptance.productPromotionRule: Keep TESTE_NON_APPROUVE after this pilot. Promotion still requires two further consecutive staged successes, a new blind holdout, durable recovery and WinUI source-card validation.

stopRules: Do not execute while the persistent lifetime headroom is lower than the complete 1.10 USD per-job cap; reserving only the first call is forbidden.
Do not change the 50 USD hard stop or treat account balance as mission authorization without another explicit user-funded budget extension.
Do not execute without a paid-tier observation less than 15 minutes old.
Stop before the first model call if branch, clean-tree rule, minimum commit, bank hash, local router binary, model or provider configuration differs.
Stop before the first model call if the reference corpus cannot be sealed or has an active ingestion job; reject the pilot if the postflight seal differs.
Stop at the persistent lifetime, 1.10 USD per-job or twenty-four-provider-call or forty-eight-documentary-call guard; never purchase or reload credits automatically.
Do not run repetitions two or three after a failed or semantically unreviewed first pilot.

validatedObservations: The category-aware Planner used the exact cuisine category in seven targeted queries and retained one complementary unscoped breakfast query.
The staged dossier reached eighteen globally assignable candidates, with one lunch and one supper still missing.

The Writer used its reserved research turn to read substantive bodies for Cannelloni aux épinards and Coq au vin, then produced a complete twenty-cell table with distinct names and current evidence IDs.

The two exact item lines were newly visible after the bounded dossier, but they were not present in the Candidate Explorer checkpoint. The identity guard rejected the otherwise complete Writer table before the final Critic call.
executionResult.cause: The final Writer can request and receive new canonical bodies after a bounded Candidate Explorer dossier, but candidate binding ran before the existing Writer-selection checkpoint logic. Therefore exact late discoveries with current substantive evidence could not be admitted for their selected coordinate role, even though the Writer had found and cited them correctly.
